simple.meaning: רְעַע (rᵉʻaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “break, bruise.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Daniel, beginning at Daniel 2:40. Its contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רְעַע (H7490).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: רְעַע (rᵉʻaʻ) / H7490 is traced through Daniel 2:40 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: The fourth kingdom will be strong as iron, because iron breaks in pieces and subdues all things; and as iron that crushes all these, it will break in pieces and crush.
